_slots: {room} {door} {item} {prop} are spokenNames from level.json; {dir} ahead|behind|left|right|here; {dist} near|mid|far; {a} {b} spokenNames for clarify. Edit freely, then re-run tools/render-lines.ts.

system.ack.speaker: marlow
text: Copy.
Copy that.

system.sayagain.speaker: marlow
text: Say again, boss?
Didn't catch that, boss. Say again?

system.timeout.speaker: marlow
text: Signal's bad, say again?
You're breaking up. Say again?

marlow.look.room.speaker: marlow
text: I'm in {room}, boss.
Still in {room}.

marlow.look.door.speaker: marlow
text: There's a way to {room}, {dir}.
{room}, {dir} of me.

system.ready.speaker: marlow
text: Standing by, boss. Tell me where to go.
Ready when you are. Give me an order.

system.nothing_pending.speaker: marlow
text: Nothing to confirm, boss.
I wasn't waiting on anything.

system.nothing_to_repeat.speaker: marlow
text: I haven't said anything yet, boss.
Nothing to repeat.

client.intro.a.speaker: client
text: They said you retired. They said you can't do this anymore. I never believed them.

client.intro.b.speaker: client
text: It's Ines, Owl. The Hale Gallery keeps a ledger in the office off the main hall. Marlow is already in the lobby. Bring it out, quietly, and I will forget the rest.

client.intro.repeat.speaker: client
text: Same building. Same ledger. Try not to make it a habit, Owl.
Back again. The ledger's still in the office. Let's see if you've learned anything.

marlow.intro.speaker: marlow
text: I'm in the lobby, boss. Door's ahead of me. Whenever you're ready.
In position. Lobby. One door ahead. Your call.
curt: In the lobby. Door ahead. Go.

marlow.callback.spotted.speaker: marlow
text: Last time he saw me. Not this time. Careful, okay?
Remember last run, boss. He spotted me. Let's not repeat it.
curt: Last time I got seen. Don't do that again.

marlow.callback.ignored_warning.speaker: marlow
text: Last time you sent me out right after I warned you. Patience, okay?
I called out a guard and you pushed me anyway last run. Listen to me this time.
curt: You pushed me past a warning last time. Don't.

marlow.callback.none.speaker: marlow
text: Good to work with you again, boss.
Clean run last time. Let's do it again.

marlow.move.speaker: marlow
text: Moving to {room}.
Heading into {room}.

marlow.move.quiet.speaker: marlow
text: Easing into {room}. Slow and quiet.
Quietly into {room}. This takes a moment.

marlow.door_noise.speaker: marlow
text: That door was louder than I like.
Hinge squeaked. Sorry.

marlow.arrive.item.speaker: marlow
text: I see {item}.
{item}, right there.

marlow.arrive.hide.speaker: marlow
text: I can hide at {prop}.
{prop} would cover me if I need it.

marlow.peek.room.speaker: marlow
text: Cracking it open. That's {room}.
Looking through. {room}.

marlow.peek.empty.speaker: marlow
text: Nothing in there worth mentioning.
Empty, as far as I can see.

marlow.peek.guard.speaker: marlow
text: Guard in there! Not moving yet.
He's right there in that room.

marlow.listen.heard.speaker: marlow
text: Footsteps. {dir}, {dist}.
I hear him. {dir}, {dist}.

marlow.guard.here.speaker: marlow
text: He's in the room with me!
He's right here. Right here!

marlow.listen.quiet.speaker: marlow
text: Quiet. Nothing close.
Nothing but the rain.

marlow.wait.speaker: marlow
text: Holding.
Waiting.

marlow.hide.speaker: marlow
text: Tucked in at {prop}.
Down behind {prop}. Not breathing.

marlow.take.speaker: marlow
text: Got {item}.
I have {item}.

marlow.warning.speaker: marlow
text: Guard's close, boss. {dir}.
Footsteps, {dir}, and coming. Careful.

marlow.sound.phone_ring.speaker: marlow
text: A phone is ringing. {dir}, {dist}.
Phone ringing somewhere, {dir}, {dist}.

marlow.spotted.speaker: marlow
text: He saw me! He saw me!
Hey! Somebody's seen me!

marlow.caught.speaker: marlow
text: They've got me. It's over.
Hands up. It's over, boss.

marlow.win.clean.speaker: marlow
text: We're out. Clean. You did that by ear.
Outside. Not a hair out of place.

marlow.win.messy.speaker: marlow
text: We're out, but that was loud. Let's not do it like that again.
Out. Barely. They'll know somebody was here.

marlow.refuse.unknown_target.speaker: marlow
text: There's nothing like that here, boss.
I don't know what you mean, boss.

marlow.refuse.not_known.speaker: marlow
text: I haven't seen that yet, boss.
I don't know where that is yet.

marlow.refuse.not_adjacent.speaker: marlow
text: I can't get there from here, boss.
That's not next door. One room at a time.

marlow.refuse.door_locked.speaker: marlow
text: That door's locked.
Locked, boss.

marlow.refuse.not_in_room.speaker: marlow
text: There's no door there, boss.
No door like that in this room, boss.

marlow.refuse.no_hide_spot.speaker: marlow
text: Nowhere to hide in here, boss.
There's no cover in this room.

marlow.refuse.no_item.speaker: marlow
text: It's not in here, boss.
That isn't in this room.

marlow.refuse.not_ready_to_exit.speaker: marlow
text: Not yet. I need to be at the exit with the ledger.
I can't leave without the ledger, and I need to be by the door.

marlow.refuse.game_over.speaker: marlow
text: It's over, boss.

marlow.clarify.door.speaker: marlow
text: Which door, boss? {a}, or {b}?
I see two. {a} or {b}?

marlow.clarify.room.speaker: marlow
text: Which way, boss? {a} or {b}?
{a}, or {b}?

marlow.clarify.other.speaker: marlow
text: Which one, boss? {a} or {b}?
{a}, or {b}?

marlow.alert2.speaker: marlow
text: They know someone's in the building. Radio chatter everywhere.
Alarm's going quiet-loud. They're on alert, boss.

marlow.twist.tape.speaker: marlow
text: Boss. There's a tape in the drawer under the ledger. A pen label: Fenwick, the ninth. That's the night you lost your sight. I'm bringing it out too.

marlow.nudge.speaker: marlow
text: We're burning time, boss. The ledger's in the office.
Clock's ticking. What's the plan?

marlow.lowtrust.speaker: marlow
text: Keep it short with me from here on, boss. I'm not sure I'm following your lead.

marlow.outro.win.speaker: marlow
text: In the van now, boss. Rain's stopped.

marlow.outro.caught.speaker: marlow
text: Tell the client I'm sorry. We'll go again.

marlow.chase.speaker: marlow
text: He's coming for me! Hide or move me, boss, now!
He's running at me! One move, boss! Hide or go!
curt: He's on me! Hide or move!

marlow.chase.escaped.speaker: marlow
text: Lost him. For now.
I'm clear. He's off my back, for now.

marlow.chase.caught.speaker: marlow
text: Too slow, boss. He's got me.
He's on me. It's over.

marlow.guard.alerted.speaker: marlow
text: He heard that. Footsteps turning my way, {dir}.
That was too loud. He's coming this way, {dir}.

client.intro.c.speaker: client
text: One thing. Don't read it. It's only numbers.

client.checkin.speaker: client
text: Report. Do you have it yet? Don't dawdle, Owl.
Owl. Time matters. Tell me you're close.

client.got.speaker: client
text: You have it? Good. Now come out. And Owl, don't open anything else.

marlow.story.hall.speaker: marlow
text: Portraits all down the hall, boss. Hale and his friends, pleased with themselves. Above us, a slow step and then a drag. That'll be Halloran.
curt: Portraits. And a limp above us. Halloran.

marlow.story.gallery.speaker: marlow
text: There's a music box playing in here, some art piece. A slow lullaby. Boss, that's the tune you hum when you think.
curt: A music box. Your tune, boss.

marlow.story.office.speaker: marlow
text: A photograph on the desk. A woman laughing, her arm around you, boss. You're younger. You can see. On the back it says: Owl and I, Fenwick, last good night.
curt: A photo of you and a woman. Fenwick, last good night.

marlow.story.stairwell.speaker: marlow
text: Stairs going up. There's a radio playing low up there, a ball game I think. He has all night. The metal rings under everything.
curt: Stairs. A radio up there. The metal rings.

marlow.story.machine.speaker: marlow
text: The answering machine picked up. A man says: Ines, it's Hale. Burn the ledger before Owl reads it. Call me. Boss, isn't Ines the client?
curt: The machine: Hale to Ines. Burn the ledger before Owl reads it.

marlow.story.machine.late.speaker: marlow
text: The answering machine is blinking. I played it. A man says: Ines, it's Hale. Burn the ledger before Owl reads it. Call me. Boss, isn't Ines the client?
curt: The machine: Hale to Ines. Burn the ledger before Owl reads it.

marlow.epilogue.ask.speaker: marlow
text: I played the tape in the cab. It's her, Ines. She tells Hale to make sure you're inside when the lights go. What do I do with it? Burn it, or send it?
curt: It's her on the tape. Burn it, or send it?

marlow.epilogue.retry.speaker: marlow
text: Burn it, or send it, boss?

marlow.epilogue.burn.speaker: marlow
text: Burning it. Ashes in the rain. It stays between you and her, boss, whenever you want to ask her why.

marlow.epilogue.send.speaker: marlow
text: Sending it. By morning the whole city hears her voice, and what happened at Fenwick. I'm sorry, Owl. I'll be here.

client.after.burn.speaker: client
text: Owl. I know you have it. Thank you. I'll never ask for anything again.

client.after.send.speaker: client
text: Owl, pick up. Please. Owl.
